pages.text: A giant wasp nest. Parallel comb sheets run from floor to ceiling, torn open by holes and low doorways. Honey patches and Glowmarl beds cover the floor. Thick $(item)Combwood$() trunks grow up through the comb with hollow, larva-filled cores.
